title: エキサイティング☆ロケット

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm on my way back from an outing with Seeking the Pearl when she suddenly stops dead in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Peeeew, BANG!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …! Was that a firework?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Did you just let off a firework?!
Hm? Yeah… I did. It's one of my own creations. I let it off as a test run.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Does that mean you're a fireworks maker?! That's amazing! Can you show us more of them?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The old man we bump into turns out to be a firework craftsman who owns a workspace nearby. Apparently, he often holds workshop where kids can try making their own fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: I'll be holding a workshop again soon, so I'm trying out various prototypes to show to the kids.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A workshop… How exciting! Do you have more fireworks on you right now?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: Sure do. I got loads. Do you two want to try making something?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: That's it. Make sure it's firmly attached to the bamboo stake since that's what determines the propulsive force of the rocket.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's how you make sure it flies straight up… There! Time to try launching it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whiiiz, BANG!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh! It worked! I mean, did it?! Was that a successful shot?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: Very good! Considering it was your first attempt, you did really well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl looks like she's having a great time. It's rare to see her filled with such childlike delight, and I can't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: By the by, you wouldn't happen to have any good ideas for a new creation would ya?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: I want to make more fireworks that kids'll enjoy, but honestly, I've hit a wall. I'd love to get some fresh ideas from a young'un like you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, how about making a whistling rocket that sounds like it's playing dance music while it's flying into the air?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A firework that creates an image or a shape in the sky might be fun, too! Like if it makes a star when it explodes!

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: Haha, those do sound interesting! But a firework that plays music would be tricky to construct. Perhaps with a little creativity, we could make something along those lines, though.

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: …All right, let's give it a shot. We can at least get it to produce a rhythmic beat, and getting it to make a simple star shape won't be hard either.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! I wonder if I can really make a firework that explodes into a star in the sky… Are we going to use chemicals that burn in different colors to make this work?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: You got it. You can make any color you like using this flame colorant. You can't make a star with just one firework, though. You'll have to make a ton of different types, including a mix of fountain fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's get cracking, then! Time to churn out a bunch of fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …All right! It's ready! Here's another fountain firework! That's the third one.
choice_data_list: You're really making progress! What color is the one you just made?
You're really making progress! What color is the one you just made?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That one's yellow! I already did red and orange earlier, so what color should I make next?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You've got really good taste! Let's fill the sky with a fiery star that sparkles with a warm-toned gradient!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nghhh, it's so tough trying to make the fireworks explode at a steady rhythm…

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: You're on the right track, though! You just need to adjust the length of the fuse a little more, and…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I-I think I did it! I made a collection of fireworks that'll create a star in the sky and play a rhythm you can dance to when it explodes!

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: Righty-o, let's hurry and try it out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whiiiiiz, BANG, BANG, BANG!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wow! Both the beat and star pattern in the sky are so awe-inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fantastic! What a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Well, this really is something! I've never seen anything like it!
choice_data_list: You really love firework rockets, don't you?
You really love firework rockets, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Firework Craftsman
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Well, this really is something! I've never seen anything like it!
choice_data_list: You really love firework rockets, don't you?
You really love firework rockets, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I honestly never knew firework rockets were hiding this many possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I want to make even more of them! Would that be okay? Please say yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl appears to be entirely hooked on making fireworks. It's not often she gets so eager about things.
choice_data_list: Sure. You can come back for one of his workshops sometime.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! You're coming too then, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Making fireworks was obviously super exciting, but the real reason I was so focused and had so much fun was because you were with me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I do. Setting off rocket fireworks is such a lively and positive activity. Doesn't it just make your heart race?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Every burst feels as though it's cheering me on, boosting my determination to seek more possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's why I like them so much.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. I wish I could stay here and enjoy both this view and this rhythmic booming forever…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's profile is limned by the fireworks' light and her own bright smile as she murmurs that. It warms my heart to know I was able to let her experience something so fun.
